definitions.gloss: stray dog; feral dog; wild dog
definitions.explanation: A dog living without an owner, roaming freely in the wild or in urban areas. Includes both abandoned domestic dogs and those born in the wild.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野犬|やけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I spotted a stray dog in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野犬|やけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Stray dogs are increasing in this area.

examples.japanese: {野犬|やけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{見|み}つけたら→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦{保健所|ほけんじょ}→保健所：31651_hokenjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Approaching stray dogs is dangerous, so if you find one, please contact the public health center.

notes:
{野犬|やけん} is the word of news, notices and local government; in conversation people say ⟦{野良犬|のらいぬ}→野良犬：14464_norainu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野犬|やけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: a pack of stray dogs
- {野犬|やけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be attacked by a stray dog
- {野犬|やけん}{狩|が}り: rounding up stray dogs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{野良犬|のらいぬ}→野良犬：14464_norainu⟧: stray dog; the everyday word
- ⟦{捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}→捨て犬：24573_suteinu⟧: a dog abandoned by its owner
